confirmed_findings.claim: The ACDSL fast-feedback hook unconditionally denies every write to acdsl/registry.local.json in strict/gated mode, even though that file is deliberately excluded from the frozen self-management surface and is designed to be edited locally under per-entry local_overrides gating, so no gated target repo can ever add a sanctioned local verifier override.
confirmed_findings.fix: Drop acdsl/registry.local.json from the hook's frozen-surface case entirely — either replicate overlayViolations by checking entry names against policy.local_overrides read from acdsl/policy.json, or simpler, don't gate this file at the hook layer at all and let the authoritative acdsl check catch unsanctioned entries.

confirmed_findings.claim: shipBinary's prebuilt-copy branch names the destination after filepath.Base(prebuilt) instead of out, so on Windows a prebuilt binary without the .exe extension is shipped mis-named, violating the code's own invariant that Windows outputs always carry .exe.
The prompt-start slash match is a prefix match, so a first message beginning with /railroad-review-observability would wrongly count as invocation of required skill railroad-review.
confirmed_findings.fix: Anchor the match on a space/newline/end-of-string boundary, e.g. "/$required" | "/$required "* or a [[ $first_user =~ ^/$required($|[[:space:]]) ]] equivalent.

confirmed_findings.claim: All plan directories under plans/v1-2-1/ are still -wip- (only the acdsl-policy-modes one is -done-) even though the range is the merged v1.2.1 release, violating RULE-PLAN-073 which says merged plans move to the plans-archive repo renamed done-<merge-hash>.
confirmed_findings.fix: Move the shipped plans/v1-2-1/*-wip-* directories through /plan-archive now that the range is merged.

confirmed_findings.claim: writePolicy forwards BaseRef verbatim into every distributed target's policy.json with no per-target override analogous to dist_mode, so a smine-side base_ref would leak unchanged into targets where it likely doesn't resolve.
